news.title: Flex operators lease 1.91 lakh seats across top eight cities in H1 2026: Cushman & Wakefield
news.para: Flexible workspace operators leased 1,91,306 seats across India’s top eight cities in H1 2026, up 68.4% year-on-year, according to Cushman & Wakefield. The segment recorded 8.4 million sq ft of gross leasing volume during the period, accounting for nearly 20% of total office leasing.

news.title: DTCP to intensify encroachment crackdown in compliance with HC, SC directives in Gurugram
news.para: The Gurgaon administration is intensifying its efforts to eliminate illegal constructions and encroachments. Town planner Amit Madholia highlighted that these actions are in line with court orders and prioritize public interest. The crackdown focuses on removing obstacles from public land and unauthorized building projects, with particular attention to stilt parking misuse. Residents are encouraged to report any violations and refrain from unlawful construction practices.

news.title: Patna civic body approves freehold conversion of 3,631 leasehold properties
news.para: The Patna Municipal Corporation has officially sanctioned the transition of 3,631 leasehold properties to freehold status. This initiative seeks to enhance transparency regarding property ownership and transactions. Original allottees will incur a conversion fee of ten percent based on market value, while second allottees face a twelve percent charge. The council also deliberated on addressing non-residential behaviors in residential areas.

news.title: Dhuleva Group secures rights to redevelop two-acre land in South Mumbai
news.para: Dhuleva Group will develop a luxury housing project near Marine Lines. This project has a gross development potential of approximately one thousand crore rupees. Construction is expected to commence in the first quarter of twenty twenty-seven. The development will accommodate over two hundred seventy existing residents. This initiative is part of the developer's expansion strategy in South Mumbai.

news.title: ED freezes assets worth ₹33 crore after raids against Vatika
news.para: The Enforcement Directorate has seized assets amounting to thirty-three crore rupees as part of its investigation into Vatika Ltd.'s promoters. This probe, initiated under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, targets serious allegations of fraud affecting homebuyers who suffered losses due to the non-delivery of plots from 2010 to 2012.

news.title: Dholera no longer speculative, manufacturing to drive real estate demand: Gopal Goswami
news.para: Speaking during a fireside chat at ETRealty Realty and Beyond Ahmedabad, Dr. Gopal Goswami, chairman, GAP Group, said semiconductor manufacturing, data centres and transport infrastructure are beginning to create demand for housing, commercial spaces, hospitality, co-working and industrial real estate in Dholera.

news.title: Ahmedabad: Nod for Hansol town planning scheme 67; to transform eastern riverfront skyline
news.para: After a long wait of 24 years, Hansol TP Scheme No. 67 has finally received preliminary approval, paving the way for development on over 50 hectares of land near the iconic Taj hotel and the picturesque Sabarmati Riverfront. This significant progress allows the civic body to initiate road construction and grant development permissions, reshaping the eastern riverfront skyline with new architectural projects and enhancing connectivity through a proposed tunnel alignment.

news.title: Nagpur: Kachipura survey to map 800 properties ahead of proposed BKC-style hub
news.para: The Nagpur district administration is pushing for a fresh socio-economic survey in Kachipura. This initiative aims to gather essential data on residents and properties before the redevelopment of key land. The decision comes in light of the state government's stance on unauthorized structures, with the findings expected to shape Kachipura's evolution into a vibrant commercial center.

news.title: Bombay HC rejects Shree Ganesh Builders' plea, clears way for Pohra STP project
news.para: The Bombay High Court dismissed a builder’s challenge to land acquisition for a sewerage treatment plant. The court determined that the builder did not issue a valid purchase notice and engaged in the acquisition proceedings. The claim that the reservation had lapsed was also turned down. This ruling affirms the land's reservation since 2001, permitting the long-delayed public project to resume in four weeks.

news.title: MMDR amendment brings cost relief to Tamil Nadu cement makers
news.para: South India's cement manufacturers are breathing easier following the removal of a burdensome limestone tax by Tamil Nadu. The implementation of the MMDR Amendment Bill of 2026 has facilitated this change, promising substantial annual savings for the industry. As a direct result, the outlook for financial gains in the cement sector appears more promising than ever.

news.title: Foxconn looks for 200 acres land parcel to set up technology park, Gujarat on radar
news.para: According to top sources in govt, Foxconn executives have surveyed the plot of land near Sanand and the company will take a call on finalising the location in the coming weeks. “The company intends to set up a mobile phone and other high-end electronics manufacturing plant,” a senior state govt official said, clarifying that Gujarat is not the only state being considered by the company for the new project.

news.title: About ₹2,500-crore property tax arrears from merged areas squeeze Pune civic body's finances
news.para: Facing a critical financial shortfall of Rs 2,500 crore, the Pune Municipal Corporation confronts resistance to property taxes in newly incorporated suburban regions. Residents claim that the insufficient civic services provided justify their tax withholding. Adding to the dilemma, political opposition to collection efforts has created a deadlock that burdens the current city taxpayers more heavily.

news.title: Pune cantonment board looks at prime 5.43-acre Koregaon Park land for income
news.para: Pune Cantonment Board plans to unlock commercial potential of defense land in Koregaon Park. This prime property could generate substantial revenue for the cash-strapped civic body. The board requires significant funds monthly for salaries and basic civic services. Officials submitted a proposal to the Principal Directorate of Defence Estates for sanction. Experts advise caution and professional valuation before commercial development occurs.

news.title: Infineon Tech picks up 6.3 lakh sq ft Bengaluru office in ₹750-crore rental deal
news.para: German firm Infineon Technologies has leased over 6.3 lakh sq ft office space in Bengaluru. This significant deal involves a rental payout exceeding Rs 750 crore over ten years. The company also announced its acquisition of power semiconductor startup C2i Semiconductors. This move aims to bolster Infineon's engineering and research capabilities in India.

news.title: Homeowners of DLF & Old Gurugram  denounce bulldozer action, demand regularisation of colonies
news.para: On Wednesday, a sea of frustrated homeowners in Gurugram gathered to express their anger over recent property demolitions. They accused officials of blatant misconduct, citing their negligence in addressing their grievances likely influenced by local political dynamics. The residents are calling for their properties to be regularized urgently and for specific penalties to be levied against offenders. A detailed memorandum will be delivered to the Deputy Commissioner outlining their demands.

news.title: UK moves ahead with first £10 billion wave of low-cost housing plan
news.para: The UK government is gearing up to invest ten billion pounds towards affordable housing initiatives. With a focus on social rent, sixty percent of these homes will cater to those in need. This substantial funding aims to tackle homelessness and ensure housing stability while empowering mayoral authorities to shape housing strategies that benefit their communities.

news.title: Aroundtown's profit more than halves on falling German property prices
news.para: Aroundtown faced a sharp decline in profits, dropping by over half in the first half of 2026. The downturn in German commercial property prices severely affected the landlord's earnings. Additionally, rising financing costs and inflationary pressures contributed to the company’s financial struggles. Nevertheless, they reaffirmed their annual guidance for funds from operations, buoyed by the benefits derived from their increased stake in Grand City Properties.

news.title: Australian property developer Ingenia offers to buy Peet in $711 million deal
news.para: Ingenia Communities has put forward a significant A$992.5 million bid to acquire Peet, aiming to expand its footprint in the Australian housing sector. This strategic proposal follows a trend of declining sales and diminished tax incentives for investment properties. Peet shareholders are set to receive a mix of cash and Ingenia stapled securities for each share they own, with full board approval and backing from the largest shareholder.

news.title: Home loan portfolio set to cross ₹10 lakh crore milestone this quarter: SBI chairman
news.para: State Bank of India's mortgage portfolio is nearing a significant Rs 10 lakh crore milestone.  The bank holds a substantial 28 percent market share in the home loan segment.  SBI focuses on making home loans accessible across the nation.  The lender is exploring securitisation to enhance capital recycling capabilities.  SBI expects to garner USD 10 billion from non-resident Indians and foreign investors.

news.title: Mumbai: BMC demolishes unauthorised portions in nine flats of Rustomjee Crown in two days
news.para: The BMC has intensified its demolition of unauthorized constructions within Rustomjee Crown flats, targeting nine units in just two days. This action stems from a complaint lodged by an activist, with a prior 138 notices sent to flat owners last year. The associated demolition costs are set to be recovered from the society or the individual owners.
